label: H.R. 10097
title: Earn to Learn Act

items.snippet: This bill directs the Department of Education (ED) to establish a postsecondary education match savings account demonstration grant program, through which ED…

…match savings account demonstration grant program, through which ED must award competitive grants to states and nonprofit organizations to provide certain low-income students with postsecondary education match savings…

…savings account demonstration grant program, through which ED must award competitive grants to states and nonprofit organizations to provide certain low-income students with postsecondary education match savings accounts (e.g., 529 plans).
…which ED must award competitive grants to states and nonprofit organizations to provide certain low-income students with postsecondary education match savings accounts (e.g., 529 plans).

…education match savings account for each participating student and allow such students and their families to deposit funds in their account to save for attendance at an institution of higher education or an area…

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

L000590.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
L000590.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
L000590.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
